key_provisions_or_claims: Lao PDR launches its UNESCO AI Ethics Readiness Assessment (RAM) Country Report on 27 January 2026.
RAM assesses readiness to implement the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI across regulation, institutions, infrastructure, capacity and societal impact.
Report findings will inform Lao PDR's drafting of a National AI Strategy.
Workshop co-organised by the Ministry of Technology and Communications and UNESCO with the UN Country Team.
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO event page announcing the 27 January 2026 national workshop in Vientiane to launch Lao PDR's AI Ethics Readiness Assessment (RAM) report. The report assesses readiness to implement UNESCO's 2021 AI ethics Recommendation and will inform the national AI strategy. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Lao PDR to unveil UNESCO AI Ethics Readiness Assessment report at national workshop
